comparison.objective: Build two scaffold footings in the safe board–plate–tube order; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR places and aligns large support components and inserts tubes into collars. Candidate manipulates a recessed fine fastener and small collar before cycling a fixture.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correctly stacked, upright tubes and latches sinking failures. Candidate requires force-, travel-, rebound-, and drift-bounded impacts. PR has no separate spec beyond its detailed body.
comparison.reason: Ordered structural placement and tube insertion are not equivalent to precision adjustment, locking, and dynamic performance validation.
